item.title: Cunningham scores 28 points, Pistons overcome suspensions to rout Raptors 113-95
item.description: Cade Cunningham scored 28 points, Paul Reed got 16 of his 22 in the first quarter and the Detroit Pistons beat the Toronto Raptors 113-95 in the final game before the All-Star break for both teams.

item.title: Wright, Stuelke set the tone in 15th-ranked Iowa women's 65-56 win over No. 25 Washington
item.description: Chazadi Wright scored 21 points and Hannah Stuelke scored 14 points and grabbed a career-high 16 rebounds and 15th-ranked Iowa beat No. 25 Washington 65-56 to end its three-game losing streak.

item.title: Ball and Reed lead No. 6 UConn to 80-70 victory at Butler
item.description: Solo Ball scored 24 points and Tarris Reed Jr. finished with 16 points, 10 rebounds and seven assists as No. 6 UConn held off Butler for an 80-70 victory.

item.title: Kyle Busch grabs Daytona 500 pole, chasing a win that has eluded him for 20 starts
item.description: Kyle Busch has won the pole for the Daytona 500 and has another shot at the win that has eluded him his entire career.

item.title: High school roundup: Boys and girls postseason basketball, plus bowling
item.description: A recap of Long Island high school sporting events from Tuesday and Wednesday.

item.title: Atwell scores 20 points and Toppin grabs 18 rebounds as No. 16 Texas Tech routs Colorado 78-44
item.description: Donovan Atwell scored 20 points with six 3-pointers and JT Toppin matched a career high with 18 rebounds in his 46th career double-double as No. 16 Texas Tech blew out Colorado 78-44.

item.title: Kingz scores 27 points, Syracuse pulls away in double OT to beat Cal 107-100
item.description: Syracuse outlasts California 107-100 in a wild double-overtime game, led by Nate Kingz and a late surge.

item.title: Mavericks rookie Cooper Flagg sidelined by left midfoot sprain, out for NBA's Rising Stars
item.description: Dallas Mavericks rookie teenage standout Cooper Flagg will miss their final game before the All-Star break and not play in the NBA's Rising Stars game this weekend because of a left midfoot sprain.

item.title: After a sluggish start, No. 14 Florida now looks like a team capable of a repeat
item.description: The Florida Gators are starting to look a lot like that team from a year ago.

item.title: Short-handed Heat beat Pelicans 123-111 in final game for both teams before All-Star break
item.description: Bam Adebayo had 27 points, 14 rebounds and four blocks and the short-handed Miami Heat beat the New Orleans Pelicans 123-111 on Wednesday night in the final game for both teams before the All-Star break.
